label: input x/f/0 at original positions 3-5 in sequences starting with v/u/d/k
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps), active only in the original-input phase, at orig positions 3-4 (97% of mass) and rarely 5; never at t<3, never at the delimiter or copy phase. Input token is almost always x (52% of mass), f (30%) or 0 (18%). Firing further depends on the earlier prefix: strongly enriched when the first token is v or u (69% of mass), then d or k, and when the previous token is x/f/o/j/g/r/0/n. The predicate captures ~89% of activation mass on dev but has low precision (~9%): most x/f/0 inputs at positions 3-5 in v/u/d/k-initial sequences do not cross threshold, so the exact prefix-dependent hidden-state condition is not captured. Adding a prev_tok set raises precision to ~28% (F1 0.39) at the cost of recall. Largest activations are x or f at position 3-4 after an x-containing prefix starting with v/u.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=v (+3.81), orig0=u (+3.51), prev_tok=x (+3.15), phase=0 & in_tok=x (+2.75), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=x (+2.75), orig0=d (+2.71). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.97).
